best_idea: Move part of a stack by min(requested, room): the destination takes what fits, the source keeps the rest, and every refusal (too few charges, other item id, full destination) is decided before any write.
decision_why: Take the requested-count merge and the refuse-before-write order for Frankendom stack moves; reject the per-item loot pickup (it can report false after a partial move) and the per-row DB saves. The one-ledger ruling needs refusals before writes; the all-or-nothing award comes from the planned add in the Dawn-of-Light note, with HasSpaceForItem as a capacity precheck.
acceptance: A server test moves 5 charges from a 20-stack onto a 17-stack (max 20) and asserts 3 moved, the destination holds 20, and the source holds 17; a move of a different item id is refused and both stacks are unchanged.
